description: This Java class models the 'audience' field in a JWT (JSON Web Token), providing methods to create an Audience object from a JSON value, access its principles, and compare instances. It includes functionality to parse, represent, and operate on the 'aud' claim as specified in RFC 7519.

classes.name: Audience
classes.description: Represents the 'aud' (audience) claim in a JWT, holding one or more principles and providing methods to create and access this data.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an Audience instance from a JsonValue, interpreting it as either a string or an array of strings.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an Audience instance with no principles.

methods.name: getSinglePrinciple
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the single principle if exactly one is present, otherwise empty.

methods.name: getPrinciples
methods.description: Returns the list of principles held by the Audience.
